Generación de recetas en PDF (múltiples: PDF prescription generation (multiple formats: insurer, bank)

Integración con el hospital vía HL7 FHIR: Integration with the hospital via HL7 FHIR
Los médicos oncólogos del Hospital Garra: Oncology doctors at Garrahan Hospital spend a significant part of their day manually calculating medication doses for pediatric patients and filling out paper prescriptions. The process is tedious, prone to calculation errors, and has no mechanism to remind the doctor when to issue the next prescription. The result: risk of interruptions in critical treatments and administrative load that could be automated.
Desarrollamos una aplicación web que aut: We built a web application that automates the full prescription flow. The doctor logs into the system (authenticated from the La Lunita institutional portal), selects a patient, and the system shows the assigned oncology protocol, the current cycle and the corresponding medication. With one click it generates the prescription, the system automatically calculates doses based on the patient's weight and body surface area, selects the available presentations, and exports the document as a PDF ready to sign.
El sistema tiene tres capas bien separad: The system has three clearly separated layers: the Web App (Next.js + React) as the user interface, the API App (Node.js + Express) holding all the business logic, and the Database (OracleDB) as the single repository. Everything deployed in independent Docker containers. Communication with the hospital system is done via HL7 FHIR, using endpoints like GET /fhir/Patient/:id to fetch the patient's clinical data in real time.
I was responsible for the frontend development. I designed and implemented the user interface in Next.js and React, from the patient panel to the full prescription generation flow. I worked in permanent coordination with Garrahan's medical team to validate that the UI correctly reflected the real clinical flows. I also took part in designing the data model and in the backend integration.
El mayor desafío fue mapear correctament: The biggest challenge was correctly mapping the oncology protocols, which are very complex schemes with branches depending on the patient's response. We had to design a data model that represented cycles, regimens and branches in a flexible way. Defining the integration protocol with the hospital system (on-premise, without direct access) was also complex — we solved it by clearly specifying the API contracts and implementing a FHIR mock for development.
El sistema fue entregado como Etapa 1 (p: The system was delivered as Stage 1 (automated prescription). The next planned stages are: Stage 2 — translate the prescription into a visual treatment plan (which medications, on which dates, in which doses), and Stage 3 — a stock control and traceability system for oncology medications that compares what was prescribed with what was actually delivered.
